name: Atlas
subtitle: AI technology & safety observatory
deployment_status: Static build; publishing not performed by the packaging session
coverage: A curated starter catalog, not an exhaustive record of every paper or incident.
paper_review_scope: Metadata and abstracts; not full-paper audits or replications.
technology_review_scope: Imported evidence labels retained. Most technology profiles are reference-only, not freshly verified.
privacy: No analytics or account service. Notes are session-only on shared GitHack domains; browser-local on other hosts. Export/import backups manually. Do not enter secrets.
disclaimer: Conditional technology guidance and evidence-labeled safety reporting. Not a universal ranking or a claim of complete monitoring.
source_limitations: arXiv keywords can miss relevant papers and return false positives.
Workshop, journal, repository-only, unpublished and paywalled research is not comprehensively covered.
Reported incidents are limited by public disclosure and publisher visibility.
A report may summarize multiple incidents; catalog counts are not incident counts.
Automated candidates are not promoted to reviewed incidents.
New versions invalidate abstract-review status until rechecked.
